name: Incinerate
description: The target loses its held item if it is a Berry or a Gem. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
flags: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.
Can be copied by Mirror Move.
